description: Header file defining classes and functions for translating GLSL structures and constructors into HLSL, including handling of std140 packing rules and struct definitions.

classes.name: Std140PaddingHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing std140 struct padding calculations in HLSL translation.

classes.name: StructureHLSL
classes.description: Main class responsible for translating GLSL structures and constructors into HLSL code, managing struct definitions, constructors, and packing rules.

methods.name: addStructConstructor
methods.description: Generates a constructor function for a given structure.

methods.name: addBuiltInConstructor
methods.description: Generates a built-in constructor for a given type and parameters.

methods.name: ensureStructDefined
methods.description: Ensures a structure is defined in the output.

methods.name: structsHeader
methods.description: Returns the header string for all struct definitions.

methods.name: getPaddingHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of the padding helper.

methods.name: storeStd140ElementIndex
methods.description: Stores the index of struct elements for std140 packing.

methods.name: defineQualified
methods.description: Defines a qualified struct with packing considerations.

methods.name: defineVariants
methods.description: Defines different variants of a struct based on packing.
